name: Beef Croquettes No. 1
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cold, cooked, lean beef
ingredients.originalText: one cup of cold, cooked, lean beef

ingredients.name: half a cup of cold boiled or fried ham or cold pork

ingredients.quantityText: half a cup of cold boiled or fried ham or cold pork

ingredients.name: a teaspoonful of powdered sage or parsley
ingredients.originalText: a teaspoonful of powdered sage or parsley
ingredients.quantityText: a teaspoonful of powdered sage or parsley

ingredients.name: half a cup of stock or milk

ingredients.quantityText: half a cup of stock or milk

instructions.text: Chop fine one cup of cold, cooked, lean beef
Chop fine half a cup of fat and half a cup of cold boiled or fried ham or cold pork
Mince up a slice of onion
Season all with a teaspoonful of salt, half a teaspoonful of pepper, and a teaspoonful of powdered sage or parsley if liked
Heat together with half a cup of stock or milk
When cool add a beaten egg
Form the mixture into balls, slightly flattened
Roll in egg and bread crumbs, or flour and egg
Fry in hot lard or beef drippings
Serve on a platter and garnish with sprigs of parsley

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Chop fine one cup of cold, cooked, lean beef
2. Chop fine half a cup of fat and half a cup of cold boiled or fried ham or cold pork
3. Mince up a slice of onion
4. Season all with a teaspoonful of salt, half a teaspoonful of pepper, and a teaspoonful of powdered sage or parsley if liked
5. Heat together with half a cup of stock or milk
6. When cool add a beaten egg
7. Form the mixture into balls, slightly flattened
8. Roll in egg and bread crumbs, or flour and egg
9. Fry in hot lard or beef drippings
10. Serve on a platter and garnish with sprigs of parsley
